snippet.title: Druggiemon Lost Edition 💊❓💀 Trailer
snippet.description:
The Lost Edition is an arbitrary placement in the Druggiemon franchise timeline, it’s more of a paradoxical prequel/sequel as in the beginning and the end combined, as well as a “timeline that should not exist” so you have to beat the game to destroy it. And the lore ties in with Druggiemon’s main story either way for the God Druggiemon and Anti-God (legendary Druggiemon are called Divine Druggiemon)
